Light manual
============

:Author: Light
:Version: 1.0

An IDE made of **modules**, with ``literal`` text, *emphasis* and a `link <https://example.org>`_.
See also `Usage`_ below.

.. note::

   Modules are downloaded from a registry.

Install
-------

#. Download the zip
#. Unpack it
#. Run ``light.exe``

Usage
-----

Run a file::

    python3 hello.py

.. code-block:: python

   def greet(name):
       return f"hello {name}"

term
    The definition of the term.

+-------+--------+
| Name  | Kind   |
+=======+========+
| light | IDE    |
+-------+--------+
| sbcl  | Lisp   |
+-------+--------+

.. warning:: Be careful with modules.
